notes.title: Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/5d6d8b2af14b8ff62310c4634371fc949b3d5fc8.png[/img]

Hi, I've been working hard to add the Steam Trade Cards and finally, are here!!!

I created 10 Steam trade cards. Each one is the concept of one of the machines of the game, the concepts were created by Joan, one of the main ilustrator that helped me a lot to develop the game.

Each card and concept has a long story. The story of a hard proccess in order to try to achieve a game that people could enjoy. Each machine was designed after a high number of tests and changes in order to fit well in the game, with a lot of love in every detail.

I could add a lot of more cards because I have a huge number of concepts, in the game there are around 300 objects, however the concepts selected for the Steam trade cards are the core of the game, where everything begun.

I added 5 icons that I think that will fit well and 6 backgrounds that if you see all of them you can watch some kind of story or progression of the game, I mean, since the player arrive to a new planet until the Singularity gate is built.

About the badges, they have also their own story, is how we started to think about the furnace of the game. Each one was discarded for a new one until we reach the furnace that we think could be perfect for the game. The fun fact is that none of them was added to the game, we had to make changes during the 3d modelling. 

If you compare the concepts and the finals 3d models, you can see that we had to add or change things in order to fit well in the game.

[h1]List of Additions:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added 10 Steam trade cards.
    [*]Added 5 icons.
    [*]Added 6 backgrounds.
    [*]Added badges.
[/list]


[h1]What Next:[/h1]

I would like to continue with the things that I had to hold, like see if I can increase the bright during the night or see if I can add a bed to avoid night. I would like to finish the machine that will protect the planet of asteroids or see if is better to simple add an option button in the game, and I will continue fixing bugs and adding more little features.

I would like to see if the community can help with more languages and add it to the game or see other ways to add new languages.

[h1]Thank you for your support and patience.[/h1]

notes.title: Updates and Fixes #38: New Engine Version.
notes.content:
[h1]4.19 Engine Version:[/h1]

Hi, I finally updated the game to the 4.19 version of the Unreal 4 engine. It was a very hard work change all the code from a very old version to the latest and test every aspect of the game in order to check that everything is ok.

As you know I ported the game to the 4.18 and I had a crash when I ran the game in the public build. After I changed the game to the 4.19, I could identify the problem and I solved it. Now the game works in the public build.

The game is really huge, so its nearly impossible to test everything so maybe could appear new bugs, if you find some bugs, please share to the community the bug and I will try to find it and fix it.

[h1]Loading:[/h1]

During the waiting of the new version of the engine, I have improved a very important part and I have fixed some bugs. The important part is the loading of the game. I rewrited some part of the code in order to improve it, because I found that in some cases the game freeze during the loading. I added a percentage counter so the player can easily see if the game is loading or it is freeze. The loading part should work better now.

[h1]VR issues:[/h1]

I disabled the plugins related to the VR, in order to try if the plugins are starting the game in VR mode when the player has a VR. I don't have any VR head set so I will really appreciate if anyone can say if now the game doesn't start the VR steam mode.

[h1]List of fixes:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Updated the game to 4.19 Engine version, we came from 4.10.
    [*]Updated the menu when the player starts the game, now it is possible to see easily the spaceship is travelling to the galaxy.
    [*]Added Percentage counter in the Loading Menu.
    [*]Added Sun mesh model in Asteroid Map and Gas Planet Map.
    [*]Fixed bug when getting info from the machines that could crash the game.
    [*]Fixed bug when Inventory menu was opened the player could click the machines of the map
    [*]Fixed bug when any Menu is opened the player could move any object.
    [*]Fixed bug related to fluid tanks that could crash the game when the player travel to a new map.
    [*]Fixed bug related to movement info not showed in the Galaxy map. 
    [*]Removed message when exiting Tech Menu.
    [*]Removed VR plugins and other no necessary plugins.
[/list]

[h1]What Next:[/h1]

I will continue fixing bugs and polishing the game. During the change of the engine version, I found some bugs that I couldn't fix on time, so I hope fix it soon and update the game. 

I would like to add the Mouse sensitivity option, Nuclear Power Plant and the Computer Machine that avoid the planet being hitted by asteroids (I have to think a name). I would like to finish of preparing the game for future translations and add more little features.

[h1]Thank you for your support and patience.[/h1]

The idea is to avoid the electric flickering of the machines when the game starts, during the change from day to night or when there is a desync of the electric network when the batteries are powering the net.

With the Electric Internal Battery the flickering problem dissapear and the transition of the day night will be smooth. notes.title: Updates and Fixes #34: Galaxy Status Menu
notes.content:
[h1]Galaxy Status Menu:[/h1]

In this new update I added a new menu with different options that will appear when the player selects a new game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/22b5f4b52f958ad527309413a2384738d4ce33f1.jpg[/img]

In this new menu, the player will choose in what moment of the story of the galaxy will play and who will be. There are three possible choices. To be the first explorer of the galaxy. To be the first colonist of the galaxy or to be a person who was born in the galaxy.

The choice is important because the player will access to different buildings or options in the game. I mean, if the player chooses to be the first colonist, all the trade and colony buildings will be available at the beginning. if the player selects born in the galaxy, all the trade and colony buildings will be available plus the battle button in the inventory menu.

I think with this new layer of options, the player can configure how to play the game, I mean, being the explorer, the player has to focus on extract resources directly from the ground in different planets and try to survive with that. However, being the colonist, the player can extract the resources in one planet, trade with them, and get new resources with the credits earned.

[h1]List of fixes:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Galaxy Status Menu.
[/list]

[h1]What Next:[/h1]

Finding and fixing bugs, polish and maybe add little things like the previous updates. 

[h1]Thank you for your support and patience.[/h1]

notes.title: Updates and Fixes #33: Control Computer
notes.content:
[h1]Updates and Fixes #33: Control Computer:[/h1]

[h1]Control Computer:[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/ff60d1423386602a20bd371d666e9b1803112950.jpg[/img]

I focused this new update to improve the number of objects at the same time on conveyors belt. I rewrote all the code related to the minerals and products and I achieved to increase the amount of objects. The game had the limit in 100 objects at the same time, with the new code I increase this number to 500.

Instead of change the number by default to 500 in the game, or add an option in the gameplay menu, I left the default number to 100, and I added a new machine called the Control Computer. I think this way add more inmersion to the game, because when the player reachs the max limit, a message appear that the base control can't handle more objects at the same time in order to maintain the base stability. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/85346a01468d3ac3a2dea0162f8758f01d922832.jpg[/img]

The player only can change the max number of objects if places a computer in the map. So each map can have different limits.

In order to change the max number of objects per map, the player only has to place the Computer in the map, select it, and press B key to increase the number or N to decrease the number. A value will show the current amount.

[h1]List of fixes:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added Control Computer.
    [*]Increase number of objects at the same time on conveyors belt.
    [*]Optimized the number of objets on conveyors belt.
[/list]

[h1]What Next:[/h1]

Finding and fixing bugs, polish and maybe add little things like the previous updates. 

[h1]Thank you for your support and patience.[/h1]

In this new updated. I added new batteries models to the game. These new models will help the player to store a high quantity of power with less amount of batteries. Each battery adds a 1 second of desync in the electric network, so it is better to have a low number of batteries at the same time.

With the new models, it is possible to have less batteries in the planet map, so the electric network won't suffer a long desync time.

The Battery Mk II can storage 6000 W that its equivalent to 4 Basic Batteries. 
The Battery Mk III can storage 20000 W that it's equivalent to 12 Basic Batteries.

notes.content:
[h1]Updates and Fixes #30: Stations and Solar Panel with Battery:[/h1]

In this new update I fixed a lot of important things and I added to the game something that I think is important in order to make the game more friendly for new players, The Stations.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/e70befb5b2e7595c82a279d234842c0fd3b63923.jpg[/img]

Stations are pre made structures with all the necessary objects that a machine requires to work. For example, the Water Pump Station has a water pump, a solar panel, wires connected, and some pipes. The Ore Station has the Ore Extractor, Solar Panel, a Robotic arm, some conveyor belts and a Chest... The player only has to put the water station over a water spot or the ore station over a mineral vein and all the objects will appear and the machine will start to work. With this method the player can build a base really quickly and learn how everything works.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/c121333a3895071f7e985ad8a53e2602bdbd82f5.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/9171537b67eb47cca758ca481879b7f620ac05b0.jpg[/img]

I think with the stations, the player can learn how the machines and the robotic arms and other objects works together, only watching the stations, and for example the player can use the furnace station, remove the furnace and put other machine that uses the same objects to work.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/3a62974d14cbc97c9d1c963ae9b9cf664b75e259.jpg[/img]

I added 9 stations, that I think will help the player to understand how each main machine works and I also added a colony station that will show how to setup a initial colony with all the necessary buildings. 

I have an idea in my mind that the player can beat the game using only stations, so the player that don't like put pipes or wires can only focus in create stations that trasnform objects in other objects. I need the feedback of the community to know if that is a good idea in order to develop more this idea.

I added too a Solar Panel with Battery. This new machine can work during the night because it has a battery integrated. This battery can work during heavy storms.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/8aa764008bba2ba8a5cf5449df8c9602327ba5cb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Updates and Fixes #30: Stations and Solar Panel with Battery:[/h1]

In this new update I fixed a lot of important things and I added to the game something that I think is important in order to make the game more friendly for new players, The Stations.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/e70befb5b2e7595c82a279d234842c0fd3b63923.jpg[/img]

Stations are pre made structures with all the necessary objects that a machine requires to work. For example, the Water Pump Station has a water pump, a solar panel, wires connected, and some pipes. The Ore Station has the Ore Extractor, Solar Panel, a Robotic arm, some conveyor belts and a Chest... The player only has to put the water station over a water spot or the ore station over a mineral vein and all the objects will appear and the machine will start to work. With this method the player can build a base really quickly and learn how everything works.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/c121333a3895071f7e985ad8a53e2602bdbd82f5.jpg[/img]

In this new update I added to the game the ground battles. The Ground battles are like mini games, where the player has to deploy some troops in base of the Military Points that has gathered in order to win the battle.

notes.content:
[h1]Updates and Fixes #25: Trade OutPost and Future Colony[/h1]

In this new update, I added a new feature that I think is important for the game and can give a lot of future possibilities. Trade.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/2502e6258f1922c3b6ae1795d5b92e7ba8533c13.jpg[/img]

[h1]Currency:[/h1]

I added the currency to the game in order to achieve the trade. In the inventory menu the player can see the amount of money who has.

[h1]Trade OutPost:[/h1]

Two new buildings are available, one is the Trade OutPost, where the player can buy or sell objects in the chests, and the other is the Trade OutPost Liquids, where buy or sell different liquids. 

Both buildings can be upgraded using the currency to get new chest or tanks with new objects or liquids.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/b7e117c76764246db668c8144500059bf4a028ce.jpg[/img]

[h1]Robotic Arm SMART Trade:[/h1]

Also a new Robotic Arm SMART Trade has been added. The idea is that the Robotic Arm can buy automatically to the Trade OutPost, creating automatic production lines, the player can buy some supplies like ore and sell the final product like ingots or plates or gears for a profit.

[h1]List of new content:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Fixed Problem with collision of the Long Transport Conduit.
    [*]Improved collision with the Transport Conduit.
    [*]Added 3d Model of Oxygen Bottle.
    [*]Added Trade OutPost.
    [*]Added Trade OutPost Liquids
    [*]Added Robotic Arm SMART Trade.
[/list]

[h1]What Next:[/h1]

[h1]The Colony:[/h1]

I'm working in the second part of the trade and research feature. The Colony.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/2f6705ad84cb9f138f2754acea028aa54977feec.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/48c8bc995592239ed96d1a0047126ec55d2c4273.jpg[/img]

When I was thinking about the research feature, I thought instead of add a new line of research machines why no create some kind of little colony where some researchers investigate the new tech. 

With this idea the player can bring more life to the bases and planets. So in overall there will be a zone with machines like an industrial zone and other zone with the colonist places like a little town.

And after thinking a way to do it simple I thought that using the same idea of the conveyors belts, the colonists could walk for a corridor that are indicated by an arrow and enter in different buildings in order to satisfy their needs like food, sleep and happiness, so the player has to design the colony in a efficient way so the colonist can work, research and also live. There are bifurcations depending on the need so it is possible to reduce the paths or create a new ones.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/c0d1d2cad504f087c093a1ad0a6d3a03369264dc.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/86fe05c3a6dc4332a7b7c3a588d383d9b23f084c.jpg[/img]

In the game you can toggle the walls of the colony in order to have a better view of the colonists.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/fe3bcd267094235ef7e2c8e259d999c0df9f6d98.jpg[/img]

It is necessary to hire each colonist so the idea of earn money in the trade outpost is connected directly to the colony and the research tree.

I hope to release the colony soon, so the community can test it. If the community like the idea I can create more buildings or different needs for the colonist and increase the colony or add events.

Here you can see some colonists working in the Trade OutPost generating some extra income for the player.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/80700580002d6a91fd530b4fafe0fcc4184d5959.jpg[/img]

It is important to say that there will not be micromanagement of the colonists, I mean it is not possible to give them specifics orders, they will try to survive in the colony that the player designed for them.

[h1]The Bed:[/h1]

I tried the bed idea, increasing the game speed to reach the day, but it drops a lot the FPS and also appear new problems because there a lot of process that occurs at the same time quickly so sometimes it could crash the game. So I could add the bed idea but everything will be frozen until the players wake up. The idea is adding a personal or overseer building with a bedroom, so the player can add the buidling to the colony. There is a bedroom building with 4 beds however is for the colonists.

[h1]The Idea:[/h1]

I think with this new two features the trade outpost and the colony the game will add a lot of more hours of gameplay. 

Because now it is not only manage a factory to get resources, now will be manage a factory to get resources and also to sell/buy goods and at the same time manage the colony in order to earn money and research new techs. 

If the game grows well and the community like the new features I'm thinking to add more final goals, like has an amount of credits, has a colony with a number of colonists and an average happiness of 75%, and also create different types of colonist like worker, researcher and biologist and the biologist has to find a cure of a plague like I talked time ago, so other goal could be send a cure to the earth using the singularity gate.

I think with the new features there is a new world of possibility, like create a passenger trains, or transport the colonists to other planets with the spaceship, or maybe create a little army in order to attack other planets and get resources.

[h1]Thank you for your support and patience.[/h1]

[h1]Updates and Fixes #24: Autosave, More Inventory Improvements and New Big SpotLight.[/h1]

In this new Update I fixed, added and improved a lot of things that the community asked. Most of the new things are related to the inventory.

[h1]Autosave[/h1]

Finally the Autosave is active and working well. The game will save the game each 5 minutes.

[h1]Day/Night Cycle[/h1]

I improved the transition between night and day, the transition now is not harder than before. I also added a Big spotlight that will light a big area, so working during the night will be easier than before. 

[h1]Bed[/h1]

I'm thinking to add a bed to the game, the idea is that the player uses the bed and avoids the night. Meanwhile the player uses the bed all the machines will be stop. I will wait until the feedback of the community about this idea.

There are more things new, I will list below.

[list]
    [*]Modified Pitch of some SFXs, Laser Loop SFX, Alarms Loop SFX.
    [*]Fixed problem with the Escape key button and the inventory.
    [*]Fixed problem with the "I" key button and the inventory.
    [*]Improved time of opening inventory.
    [*]Improved Day/Night Cycle Transition.
    [*]Added Autosave.
    [*]Added Big SpotLight.
    [*]Added button inside inventory to get all from chests and machines.
    [*]Now Crafted items will go to the Quick Inventory first.
    [*]Now Deleted items will go to the Quick Inventory first.
    [*]Added Shift-click feature to move objects quickly between inventory and machines/chests.
    [*]Added new window with info of resources gathered by the player during mining.
    [*]Added Info when you can't delete an object because your inventory is full.
    [*]Added 3d model of the Food Crate.
    [*]Fixed issue in the Ore Extractor when the player puts an object in the output slot and the Extractor change the object.
[/list]

[h1]What Next: [/h1]

I would like to start to design how the Research will work and the machines that the player will need. Also I would like to review all the things that are not working well and fix it as soon as possible.

[h1]Thank you for your support and patience.[/h1]

[h1]Updates and Fixes #22: Environment Update and Turrets.[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/1a68fd274c9ef74a9dcebb9243b226e83ed64037.jpg[/img]

The most of the new things are related to the enviroment, the idea is to create a more inmersive map for the game, so I added some mountains and cliffs, so the map is not flat anymore, it is incredible how with a few mountains and rocks the feeling of a enviroment can change totally.

I also added some ambiental fog and weather. Related to the weather I added two different storms, soft storm and heavy storm, the soft storm increase the fog and disable the solar power generator because the weather is cloudy, the heavy storm disables solar power generator and discharges the batteries. notes.content:
[h1]Updates and Fixes #21: Geothermal Power Plant, Geysers, Transport Conduit Line, Electric Line, Water Line, Oil Line, Valves and Electric Switch.[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/5f65a83aa7ba8b6196019f9677b18b38105f3dc0.jpg[/img]

In this new update I added several new objects to the game. The main objective of all the new objects is connect mid-far bases to the main base. So the player could connect electricity, water, oil or transport minerals or objects from the far distance.

[h1]Valves and Electric Switch:[/h1]

I added valves for all the fluids, with this new object the player can open or close the valve and the fluid will not continue to the next pipe.
Also I added the Electric Switch, it works like the valves.
With the valves and the switch the control of the net will be easier to limit the use of certain machines in order to optimize the different supply lines.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/84003ad6bf99938571b6c7c34e54856f69249ffd.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/8c8f73dd1797ed5567ecd9c6e577a8ba9bf9ad42.jpg[/img]

[h1]Electric Lines, Water Lines, Oil Lines:[/h1]

I added long lines of water, oil and electric power. The player could connect far bases with a few lines, or can build water pumps in far spots and connect the water with the main base with the long water line. The same idea for the oil pumps.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/e7fc40e4cc3512bf7ed3ac199357af4096f5f4b3.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/5ecc9678648720dda0a8b1025cceb6e998cf549e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Transport Conduit Line:[/h1]

In order to transport minerals or objects from very far distances, the better way is use the train, however for a mid-far distance base there is a gap in the game. 

So in the new Update I added the Transport Conduit Line. With this new line you can transport objects from a mid-far distance base in a easy way and receive the products in the main base really fast.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/1901617883b9b42378c264f61ad708662d4cead3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Geysers and Geothermal Power Plant:[/h1]

I added to each planet map four geysers. It looks like the water spot but with a steam column. Over the Geysers the player can put the new Geothermal Power Plant. This new power plant give 10.000 Watts and is a renewable energy. So it is a good mid-late game power supply for the base.

However Geysers are mid-far from the center of the map, so the player will need to use the Electric Lines to connect them to the base.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/c385c202308d853ac4261e146d837137a941526f.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/fa730523393e86570e611f2cc0a7457073306faa.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8109016/21a8c40a65d7c77c52cb6d74a9e0c3a06d58c99b.jpg[/img]

[h1]What Next:[/h1]

I'm working in adding more environment objects to the map, like different mountains and other effects. I have to test some ideas and see how it works. I hope to have it soon.


[h1]List of new content:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added Acid,Water,Fuel,Oxygen,Oil Valve.
    [*]Added Electric Switch.
    [*]Added Electric Line.
    [*]Added Water Line.
    [*]Added Oil Line.
    [*]Added Transport Conduit Line.
    [*]Added Geyser.
    [*]Added Geothermal Power Plant.
    [*]Added Auto align for pipes and wires.
[/list]

[h1]About Technology Tree:[/h1]

I'm still thinking the best way to add the technology research. I think instead of a normal tech tree with a limited number of technologies, maybe I will add some kind of select random tecnology. 

I mean, The player will not know the technology tree, the lab will show some options (maybe three or more) each time a technology has been researched and the player should select one each time, so maybe the player chooses to investigate less power consumption instead of more productivity and each new technology cost more. 

So the idea is that the game can create the technologies so the player can investigate all the time until the price to investigate is really high, of course will be fixed technologies like new machines or other improvements.

I have to think more about it. 

[h1]Thank you for your support and patience.[/h1]

notes.content:
[h1]Updates and Fixes #18: Train.[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/X7xKGp3.jpg[/img]

[h1]In this updates and fixes I would like to talk about the Train.[/h1]

The idea of the train is to give to the player a better tool to transport products or minerals from far distances to the core of the base. In the past could not be useful because far of the center of the map, there is nothing. However I added a second layer of mineral veins in a far distance of the center of the map.

The mineral veins of the center of the map have a quantity of mineral around 1500 units, more or less, the veins on the edge of the map have around 5 or 10 times the normal quantity. It looks great, so it is interesting to extract in the far places, however there isn't water spots far of the center of the map, so it is not viable to build a base at the beginning of the game far of the center, because the player couldn't survive without water.

So the idea is to start with a base in the center of the map, and when the player has all the machines to survive, search for a good mineral vein in a far distance from the base, build a little outpost and connect it with a train to the core base in order to transport minerals or products.

The use of the train is easy. The player only has to build the locomotive, and place it over a rail. behind the locomotive place some train wagon. The direction of the train is based of the direction of the rail. The player can select the train locomotive and press use key to configure the speed level of the train and the time in seconds that the train will stop in each station.

I added also a robotic arm for the train. It will work only if it has a stopped train behind. So when there is a stopped train, the robotic arm could pick some products from machines or storage and put them inside the train wagon. All the others robotic arms can pick objects from the train wagon. 

[h1]What Next:[/h1]

I'm working on the SpaceShip and the SpacePort/Landing Zone. I made a SpaceShip chassis with all the necessary machines inside and outside, so the player has only to deploy the spaceship and connect the different parts with the wires and pipes. 

When the player deploys the SpaceShip for the first time, It will search for an empty spaceport to deploy, the same for the SpaceShip Core.

I hope to finish it as soon as possible and show it and explain how it works.

notes.title: New Engine PREVIEW
notes.content:
[h1] Finally the Game in the new Unreal 4 Engine is here [/h1]

After three months of insane work, I finally moved the game to the new Unreal 4 Engine.

First of all, I apologize about three months of lack of information, but I wasn't really sure if I would port all the game in a short amount of time, so I preferred to have the game port in a near end status in order to make the first announcement.

First reason to move the game to the new Engine is because with the new Windows 8 and 10, I wasn't really sure if the old game engine could work properly on those OS. So If any player test the new game version in a windows 8 or 10 and works well please post it.

The other important reason is the use of 64 bits, right now the game should work more smooth than the old 32 bits version.

The third reason is because all the reflection effects and metal materials are really awesome, and everything in the game is made of metal so when the day is in the sunset all the orange color is reflected in the objects and the vibe is amazing. Try the Ice planet, the reflects on the terrain are really great.

Of course there are more reasons, but for me, I started to move the game to the new Engine because of the last three reasons.

[h1]New Gameplay[/h1]

I totally change the gameplay of the game, I mean, I got rid of the mouse in the gameplay, right now when I play the game I feel really free, and for me is really easier to build and move with the current building system, and with the new highlight is really easy to know which block are you selecting. Please try it and tell me what do you think about the new gameplay.

[h1]Not finished yet[/h1]

The new version of the game don't have yet all the old features, like jetpack or the research tree or certain blocks light the beacon. I'm still working on it, and I hope to finish all of them as soon as possible. So it is very possible to find crash bugs or lack of machines.

notes.title: New Engine PREVIEW
notes.content:
[h1] Finally the Game in the new Unreal 4 Engine is here [/h1]

After three months of insane work, I finally moved the game to the new Unreal 4 Engine.

First of all, I apologize about three months of lack of information, but I wasn't really sure if I would port all the game in a short amount of time, so I preferred to have the game port in a near end status in order to make the first announcement.

First reason to move the game to the new Engine is because with the new Windows 8 and 10, I wasn't really sure if the old game engine could work properly on those OS. So If any player test the new game version in a windows 8 or 10 and works well please post it.

The other important reason is the use of 64 bits, right now the game should work more smooth than the old 32 bits version.

The third reason is because all the reflection effects and metal materials are really awesome, and everything in the game is made of metal so when the day is in the sunset all the orange color is reflected in the objects and the vibe is amazing. Try the Ice planet, the reflects on the terrain are really great.

Of course there are more reasons, but for me, I started to move the game to the new Engine because of the last three reasons.

[h1]New Gameplay[/h1]

I totally change the gameplay of the game, I mean, I got rid of the mouse in the gameplay, right now when I play the game I feel really free, and for me is really easier to build and move with the current building system, and with the new highlight is really easy to know which block are you selecting. Please try it and tell me what do you think about the new gameplay.

[h1]Not finished yet[/h1]

The new version of the game don't have yet all the old features, like jetpack or the research tree or certain blocks light the beacon. I'm still working on it, and I hope to finish all of them as soon as possible. So it is very possible to find crash bugs or lack of machines.

[h1]Thank you[/h1]

Thank you for your support and patience during the last three months.

notes.content:
[h1]Robotic Arm SMART and Transport Conduit Update[/h1]

This update is related to the production, adding new elements like the Robotic Arm SMART and the Transport Conduit.

[h1]Robotic Arm SMART[/h1]

The New Robotic Arm SMART is the best solution to optimize and increase the production of the base. The player can put different products in the same conveyor belt line and each Robotic Arm SMART will pick up only the product that has been chosen in the config. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cojk03f.jpg[/img]

Optimization is the new goal for the player, because the base has a limit of number of products at the same time, so the player has to keep a low number of materials over the conveyor belts. The first best option is using Transport Conduit, the second step is using chests to keep the materials and the third step is using  Robotic Arms SMART in the same conveyor belts line.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ocASzlz.jpg[/img]

The Setup of the Robotic Arm SMART is really easy, the player has only to select the Robotic Arm and press the Use key, A new info inside the inventory will appear and the player could configure the parameters, like the product that the robotic arm can pick up or the maximum angle of movement.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gkwfbkt.jpg[/img]

[h1]Transport Conduit[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GAyvetI.jpg[/img]

The Transport Conduit is the best solution to avoid the long lines of conveyor belts. it is faster and keep the number of products low.

[h1]The list of Updates and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added Transport Conduit. Now you can replace you long conveyor belt lines to a line of transport conduits. With this change the products will travel faster, safer and it will allow the player to have the number of products at the same time in a normal situation.
    [*]Added Robotic Arm SMART. In this configurable robotic arm, the player can choose which product will pick up the robotic arm and the maximum angle of rotation.
    [*]The Robotic Arms will not get products from machines or chest until the number of objects at the same time is less than 100.
    [*]Added High Speed Hydraulic Press. This new Hydraulic Press will increase your production of plates and gears.
    [*]Added Message: Asteroid hits object.
    [*]Added Message: Too many objects on conveyor belts.
    [*]Added Particle System to Asteroid, added new explosion particle system when the asteroid is destroyed.
    [*]Fixed Laboratory Screen of the Laboratory computer 3d model.
    [*]Fixed issue, Robotic arm gets the product from other Robotic arm when it hasn't finished the movement.
    [*]Fixed conveyor belt velocity when there are too many products over conveyor belts.
    [*]Fixed Stars Sky dome on the Pure Iron Planet.
    [*]Removed collision of mountains with Space Ship elements.
    [*]Removed plastic as requisite to build the Automatic Turret.
[/list]


Thank you for your support and patience.

notes.content:
[h1]SpaceShip Fuel Update[/h1]

This update is related to the spaceship, the fuel and the galaxy map.

[h1]Fuel Generator[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XhszPoc.jpg[/img]

A new machine has been added, the Fuel Generator, It generates fuel from coal, water and electricity. The player will need two of those machines in order to refill a fuel tank. Right now the spaceship needs fuel to travel and the oil is not in the initial planets so this machine is needed before the refinery.

It has been added new info to the spaceship. In the spaceship info you can see the total mass, total fuel, and the ratios power/mass of the warp engine. Now the player has to build the most efficient spaceship as possible because the spaceship has weight, needs fuel to go to others planets and the fuel needed to go to other planets depends on the total mass of the spaceship and the distance. Also the player needs to put engines to the Spaceship, each engine can carry an amount of mass. If the ratio power/mass is greater than 1, the spaceship will jump to the galaxy map. Each engine needs water and electricity, so it is important to carry some water tanks and some batteries if you want to come back to your homeworld.

[h1]SpaceShip Connections and Info[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/StNCViN.jpg[/img]

[h1]Galaxy Map Info[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vtzo0RF.jpg?1[/img]

[h1]The list of Updates and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Now the player needs to put engines to the Spaceship, each engine can carry an amount of mass. If the ratio power/mass is greater than 1, the spaceship will jump to the galaxy map.
    [*]Added info in the galaxy map GUI about the distance between planetas and the fuel needed to jump. The fuel needed depends on the mass of the spaceship, so a ratio fuel/mass is showed because this ratio is constant.
    [*]New machine and 3d model, Fuel Generator.
    [*]Now you can refill the spaceship with fuel. First you have to put some fuel tanks to the spaceship, then build a fuel plug pipe and plug it to your base fuel network. You will need time to fill the fuel tanks. The more mass you spaceship has the more fuel and engines needs in order to travel to other planet.
    [*]Added Oil Plug Pipe.
    [*]Updated Oxygen Plug Conduct 3d Model.
    [*]Updated Water Plug Pipe 3d Model.
    [*]Updated Wire Plug 3d Model.
    [*]Updated GUI Images of the Oxygen, Oil, Electric and Water plug pipe.
    [*]Now is not possible to build an object really near to the player, so the new object will not push the player.
    [*]Fixed issue of putting an object and the new object move to the player in an infinite loop.
    [*]Added sound to the Hydraulic Press.
    [*]Added error sound when player tries to enter a planet and the spaceship has not enough fuel.
    [*]Added error sound and message when player tries to jump with the spaceship and the ratio power/mass of the warp engine is less than 1.
    [*]Improved the Electric batteries, now it should not enter in a charge, discharge infinite loop. it needs more improvement.
    [*]Fixed the problem of the spaceship falling a little each time the map is loaded.
    [*]Added SpaceShip info when the player selects a piece of the spaceship. In the info you can see the total mass, total fuel, and the ratios.
    [*]Improved the orientation when the player puts new pieces, added automatic rotation to new pieces. With this method is easier to build network wires or pipes.
    [*]Fixed problem with the mass center of the spaceship. Now the problem of the spaceship camera that sometime was far of the spaceship is solved. 
    [*]Fixed issue of positioning a piece even if it is marked as red.
    [*]Removed the green colour when positioning new pieces, now is easier to see the rotation of the new piece without the green colour.

Thank you for your support and patience.

notes.title: Updates and Fixes #15
notes.content:
[h1]SpaceShip Fuel Update[/h1]

This update is related to the spaceship, the fuel and the galaxy map.

[h1]Fuel Generator[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XhszPoc.jpg[/img]

A new machine has been added, the Fuel Generator, It generates fuel from coal, water and electricity. The player will need two of those machines in order to refill a fuel tank. Right now the spaceship needs fuel to travel and the oil is not in the initial planets so this machine is needed before the refinery.

It has been added new info to the spaceship. In the spaceship info you can see the total mass, total fuel, and the ratios power/mass of the warp engine. Now the player has to build the most efficient spaceship as possible because the spaceship has weight, needs fuel to go to others planets and the fuel needed to go to other planets depends on the total mass of the spaceship and the distance. Also the player needs to put engines to the Spaceship, each engine can carry an amount of mass. If the ratio power/mass is greater than 1, the spaceship will jump to the galaxy map. Each engine needs water and electricity, so it is important to carry some water tanks and some batteries if you want to come back to your homeworld.

[h1]SpaceShip Connections and Info[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/StNCViN.jpg[/img]

[h1]Galaxy Map Info[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vtzo0RF.jpg?1[/img]

[list]
    [*]Now the player needs to put engines to the Spaceship, each engine can carry an amount of mass. If the ratio power/mass is greater than 1, the spaceship will jump to the galaxy map.
    [*]Added info in the galaxy map GUI about the distance between planetas and the fuel needed to jump. The fuel needed depends on the mass of the spaceship, so a ratio fuel/mass is showed because this ratio is constant.
    [*]New machine and 3d model, Fuel Generator.
    [*]Now you can refill the spaceship with fuel. First you have to put some fuel tanks to the spaceship, then build a fuel plug pipe and plug it to your base fuel network. You will need time to fill the fuel tanks. The more mass you spaceship has the more fuel and engines needs in order to travel to other planet.
    [*]Added Oil Plug Pipe.
    [*]Updated Oxygen Plug Conduct 3d Model.
    [*]Updated Water Plug Pipe 3d Model.
    [*]Updated Wire Plug 3d Model.
    [*]Updated GUI Images of the Oxygen, Oil, Electric and Water plug pipe.
    [*]Now is not possible to build an object really near to the player, so the new object will not push the player.
    [*]Fixed issue of putting an object and the new object move to the player in an infinite loop.
    [*]Added sound to the Hydraulic Press.
    [*]Added error sound when player tries to enter a planet and the spaceship has not enough fuel.
    [*]Added error sound and message when player tries to jump with the spaceship and the ratio power/mass of the warp engine is less than 1.
    [*]Improved the Electric batteries, now it should not enter in a charge, discharge infinite loop. it needs more improvement.
    [*]Fixed the problem of the spaceship falling a little each time the map is loaded.
    [*]Added SpaceShip info when the player selects a piece of the spaceship. In the info you can see the total mass, total fuel, and the ratios.
    [*]Improved the orientation when the player puts new pieces, added automatic rotation to new pieces. With this method is easier to build network wires or pipes.

notes.title: Update and Fixes #14
notes.content:
[h1]Chemical industrial Update[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/UFm69mD.jpg[/img]

The beginning of the chemical industry is here. This update add to the game the core of all the chemical industry machines. The goal is gather oil in order to produce fuel and petrochemicals that will be used to create other products like plastic. 

The Petrochemicals fluid is used to produce plastic in the plastic factory and other future components. Plastic will be the base product of some future machines in order to produce other valuables products. 

Right now the fuel is used to generate power in the fuel power plant, however it will be used in the near future to fuel the spaceship. The idea is that the Spaceship will use fuel to travel to other planets and the amount of fuel will depend on the mass of the spaceship and the distance, so the player has to build more efficient spaceships or some gas stations in order to fuel the spaceship in long trips.

Some Images of the new machines and buildings:

[h1]Oil Pump[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MiBwpH7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Refinery[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1v59e24.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fuel Power Plant[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/XXVRKkN.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/cGkRX5w.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZyPulHz.jpg[/img]

[h1]Oil Place[/h1]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zsD67Fb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Some Updates and Fixes: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added Water places, where the player has to build the water pump.
    [*]Added Oil places, where the player has to build the oil pump.
    [*]Added Deep water pump, this machine has to be build in the ground. it doesn't need water places in order to pump water.
    [*]Added Oil pump, this machine has to be build in an oil place.
    [*]Added Oil pipes.
    [*]Added Fuel pipes.
    [*]Added Plug Fuel pipe.
    [*]Added Petrochemicals pipes.
    [*]Added Oil Tank.
    [*]Added Fuel Tank.
    [*]Added Refinery, it transforms oil into fuel and petrochemicals.
    [*]Added Fuel Power Plant, it uses fuel to generate electric power.
    [*]Added Plastic Factory, it uses petrochemicals and water to produce plastic.
    [*]Added SFX Sound in the Steel Factory.
    [*]Updated Water Pump, now it needs to be build in a water place in order to get water.
[/list]

Apologize about delay and thank you for your support and patience.
